items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: they wanted to know if it would be all right to take me in a show somewhere on the road with them, and my mother liked the Chinch and Ella B. Moore shows.

ctx.x: Well anyhow, in the contest the contestants would have to come out and line up across the stage as they always do, and the Master of Ceremonies would come along behind him and put his hand over their head, and the audience would applaud how they liked the amateur, you see. So I won the third prize, you see.

And that's what happened there at the 81 Theater. So the next thing I know is my -- my mother was telling me that some people was at the house, and they wanted to know if it would be all right to take me in a show somewhere on the road with them, and my mother liked the Chinch and Ella B. Moore shows. She had been seeing them throughout the years, you know. And she said she was going to give the lady permission, but I couldn't stay away no longer than until when school starts again. I would have to be back into…
This was with the Brown Skin Models?
